boxes.title: UK land targets
boxes.body:
Permanent grassland: 5.985m ha x 14% = 837,900 ha
Croppable land: 6.1m ha x 7% = 427,000 ha
Cropped land: 4.1m ha x 7% = 287,000 ha
Croppable and cropped are alternatives

boxes.title: Observed tree growth
boxes.body:
45 Trichobel trees
Diameters converted to dry biomass per tree
Average dry biomass across trees at each visit
Observed ages 1-31

boxes.title: Planting programme and layout
boxes.body:
All planted in 2027 OR equal planting in 2027-2050
Cropland: 47.62 trees/ha; 2m strips / 30m rows
Grassland: 166 trees/ha; 2m strips / 10m rows
Alleys retain their previous use

boxes.title: Mean tree biomass through time
boxes.body:
Mean tree dry biomass at each measured age
Linear interpolation between measured ages
Use ages 1-30; assume zero biomass at age zero
Same growth assumed across planting layouts

boxes.title: Follow each annual planting cohort
boxes.body:
For every year in 2027-2056: determine cohort age, area and tree count
Tree count x dry biomass per tree at that age = cohort dry AGB

boxes.title: Aboveground carbon
boxes.body:
Dry AGB x 0.4884

Carbon fraction of shoots

boxes.title: Belowground carbon
boxes.body:
Dry AGB x 0.26 x 0.4690

Root:shoot dry-mass ratio
and root carbon fraction

boxes.title: Additional soil carbon
boxes.body:
Tree-row ESM minus arable FD
/ 32 yr = 0.6510 Mg C/ha/yr
x cropland strip area x cohort age
Grassland and alleys: zero gain

boxes.title: Sum cohorts and land types
boxes.body:
Aggregate AGB C, BGB C and additional SOC separately
Convert C to CO2 using 44/12; report annually and at 2050 and 2056

boxes.title: Carbon stocks
boxes.body:
AGB separately
Combined = AGB + BGB + additional SOC

boxes.title: AGB growth summaries
boxes.body:
PAIC: change between annual AGB stocks
MAIC: sum each cohort (AGB stock / age)
